vb_textbox.text: The Gnomes are in matched pairs. You will always have say red and brown together, or green and purple. (We all get different colours) While they switch sides, the colour pairs don't change - so find the Gnome in each pair that gives the most mushrooms and stick with that Gnome until the number of mushrooms from them reduces, then try the other colour in that Pair.Alternating Gnome colours when the number of mushrooms from a Gnome dropped worked well for me. Good luck to youI just kept repeating in my head the colours offering me the best at the time, so i knew which to pick depending on what colours appeared on the screen!
